title: What Scripture Actually Means When It Calls Work a Blessing
caption:
Work isn't the curse. Genesis had Adam working the garden before sin ever entered the picture. The ground got cursed. The work was already good.

So the goal was never to escape work, it's to do it faithfully, whether or not anyone's measuring. The resume isn't the point. The man it's quietly building is.

What's the boring task you've been doing halfway? Start there.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #discipline #purpose
